newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Record deals, futures expiry propel SAfrica shares.
newsitem.headline: Record deals, futures expiry propel SAfrica shares.

text.p: A steady stream of futures-related buying of South African heavyweight industrial shares ahead of the expiry of the September futures contract propelled the industrial index higher and marked the day in the bourse's history books with a record number of deals executed.

But dealers said some index-linked shares, unable to hold their artificially high levels, slipped off their peaks towards the close. Dealers said stocks were seen retracing from their gains on Tuesday.
The industrial index ended up almost one percent firmer or up 79.5 points at 8,185.5 hoisting the all-share index 55.9 points better to 6,926.3.
Gold stocks slid in slow trade, largely ignored in favour of activity on the industrial board, and as bullion disappointed.
The index ended down 14.1 points at 1,751.3.
